root_cause: The datepicker's keydown handler prevents default behavior for Tab key, trapping focus in the date input field and preventing keyboard navigation to the next form field.
repair_strategy: Wrap the keydown listener to allow Tab key to pass through without calling the datepicker's keydown handler, enabling native browser focus movement to the next form field.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab in the visit date field will move focus to the access notes field, allowing keyboard users to navigate the form sequentially.
functional_risks: Datepicker keyboard shortcuts involving Tab key will no longer work (unlikely as Tab is not typically used as a shortcut).
If the datepicker relies on keydown handler for Tab to close the picker, it may stay open when tabbing out.
verification_requirements: Tab key navigates from visit-date to notes field when datepicker is open.
Shift+Tab key navigates from notes field to visit-date field when datepicker is open.
Datepicker remains open when clicking inside it after tabbing into the input field.
Datepicker closes when tabbing out of the input field to another form field.
